items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: My first job was with Johnny Peronis' band.

ctx.x: I see. Did you play with any bands before you got paid? I got paid? Or any little, just groups, not a regular band. Just guys getting together. No, no, no.

No, I don't know, no. My first job was with Johnny Peronis' band. I got down the quarter for that. I don't know. We played a, that was a, what do you call it? One of those rallies. Somebody was running for something. I don't know. And that happened to be at Charter and, Charter and St. Rock. On the corner of Charter and St. Rock, Street Chet. Down the quarter, I got a little bit. I had all the beer we could drink. Sandwich we could eat. That was good, man. Good pay. I was happy. I was happy if I didn't get paid.…
Period. How do you spell Proudhonis? I'm often wondering.
